title: How Do You Book a Surprise Boat Trip in Madeira Without Spoiling It?
description: Book in your own name, keep every message on your phone, give just two clues: what to wear and when to leave the hotel. The marina walk is your part to plan.
heroAlt: Two people seen from behind walking along the seafront promenade towards Marina do Funchal
keywords: how to book a surprise boat trip in madeira
boat trip gift surprise partner madeira
what to wear on a boat trip madeira
